# pg

**Tag**: database

## 简介

Pg is the Ruby interface to the PostgreSQL RDBMS. It works with PostgreSQL 10 and later.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/ged/ruby-pg
- 文档: http://deveiate.org/code/pg
- 更新日志: https://github.com/ged/ruby-pg/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/pg
